props.name: background
props.description: What is behind the glass: `city` or `bokeh` (drawn in code), an image URL, or a canvas. The glass refracts this image — not the live page underneath it.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How hard it is raining, from 0 (dry: the drops already there stay put) to 1 (a downpour).

props.name: dropSize
props.description: Multiplier for the size of the drops.

props.name: fog
props.description: How strongly the glass fogs, from 0 (clear) to 1 (frosted).

props.name: fogReturn
props.description: Seconds for a wiped patch to fog over again.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the rain. Wiping still works.

props.name: wipe
props.description: Let pointer drags wipe the fog like a finger. Sets `touch-action: none` on the pane.

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the scene for assistive tech. Without it the pane is decorative and hidden.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when rendering starts, or when it falls back.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn on top of the glass.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
